google-ima-live-pcs.observation: Official live IMA response contains securepubads.g.doubleclick.net/live/pcs/view with nonempty xai, sai and sig. No impression or event callback was fired.

spotify-image: Image endpoint only. JS collector and JS event payloads remain outside this pack.
No blanket uid, alias or forwarding-header requirements are applied to ordinary image pixels.
Lead values retain empty and opaque forms. Unknown image actions are advisory.
Session uniqueness, deduplication, delivery and account eligibility require external evidence.
stackadapt-pixel: Pinned public GTM producer, not a published backend rejection schema. All producer-specific findings are advisory.
Opaque identifiers, custom event properties and browser-specific variants remain open.
Only property object shape is checked. Custom member semantics are not guessed.
quora-pixel: Pinned public qevents SDK profile, not a published backend rejection schema. Findings are advisory.
The SDK hash prevalidation accepts alphanumeric characters beyond hex. This profile intentionally preserves that behavior.
No UUID-only pixel ID, closed event list, required noscript SDK marker or numeric-only conversion-value policy is inferred.
No cryptographic digest authentication, destination acceptance or deduplication claim.
yandex-adfox-links: Only documented /ads/adfox/{account}/getCode and goLink simple links are selected.
Runtime /adfox/{account}/event and goLink URLs can carry pr=a. They do not inherit numeric randomization requirements.
Randomness, campaign activity, targeting and per-request uniqueness are external.
google-ima-live-pcs: Exact securepubads.g.doubleclick.net/live/pcs/view only. Other host-route combinations remain unclaimed.
Opaque signature authentication and server rejection policy are unpublished. Completeness remains advisory.

privacy: Primary public docs, offline producer execution and authored synthetic fixtures. No captured customer identifiers or signed callbacks are published.
